scripts.db:test: bunx supabase db reset && bunx supabase test db
scripts.validate:all: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate plugin
scripts.test:mod: claude plugin validate plugin && claude plugin test plugin
scripts.site:deploy: bun run site:build && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name coffeebreak-mod --branch main
scripts.web:deploy: wrangler pages deploy public --cwd web --project-name cbreak-web --branch main
